method: For a single living enemy, evaluate the six captured conditional BEFixedDamage rows using the pre-hit card arguments, player dimension property and live caster/card/target state layers; require all eligible rows to yield one value, then run the recovered Fixed pre-hit formula and compare with recorded castDamage.
limitations: All outcomes were decoded before calculation; none is an independent holdout or publication credit.
The 85 hits are 30 actions within one replay, not independent battles or players. The boosted branch was not observed.
The recorded combat build is unknown; matching historical expression and effect behavior cannot prove engine-version identity.
This compares pre-hit castDamage only, not actual HP loss, callbacks or complete battle behavior.
No player, account, replay, role-instance or card-instance identifier is published.
